header.greeting: I can see every session, note and folder in {{projects}}. Ask what’s going on, or hand me work.
header.greetingNoProjects: Add the projects I should work on in my settings, or just ask me something.

intro.title: Meet Monos
intro.body: Agents of your own that live on the rail and work across your projects. They remember what matters and pick up habits they run on their own.
intro.hideHint: Hide monos from the rail. Turn them back on in Settings › Monos.
intro.cardBody: Agents of your own that work across your projects and run habits on their own.

settings.title: Settings
settings.soulDescription: Defines who this bot is and the rules it follows. Always included in its context.
settings.habitsDescription: Recurring tasks this bot runs on its own.
settings.memoryDescription: Facts and preferences this bot remembers.

reset.label: Reset conversation
reset.title: Reset {{name}}'s conversation?
reset.body: All messages in this Mono's conversation will be deleted and any active reply will be stopped. This can't be undone.
reset.kept: Its soul, memory and habits will be kept.
reset.description: Clear all messages and start fresh
reset.descriptionStay: Clear all messages and start fresh. Its soul, memory and habits stay.
